reliability: machine transcript (two passes); the announcements are clear, but long music stretches contain no speech
framing: After the opening info tokens, start the track. A villain voice says the lair self-destructs in 15 minutes; the track itself is the clock.

timeline_track_seconds.event: Countdown starts: "15 minutes". Play begins (about 1:40 into the track).
Twist: the villain jumps the countdown straight to "5 minutes".
Spoken 10-to-1 countdown; at about 12:48 into the track the bomb goes off if it is not yet defused (the villain gloats).
Outro joke: the villain notes the bomb blew minutes ago and that the 15-minute track length was never your real time limit.

implementation: Real-time mission: about 668 s of actual play (track 100 s to 768 s), with a fake '15:00' display that jumps to 5:00 at 337 s of play. Fail if the mission is not won by then.
gaps: Whether the bomb is meant to explode exactly at the spoken zero (assumed); no other rule changes were heard.
